Author: Group 1
Title: Building with Care
Body: Working together as Group 1 taught us that constructing software is much like building a faith community: every line of code requires care, intent, and structural integrity.

Author: Student Contributor
Title: Logic with Purpose
Body: Through this project, I learned that computational logic can reflect the order and purpose we study in theology when it is guided by humility and service.

Author: Student Contributor
Title: Faith and Logic
Body: Faith and logic are not opposing forces, but two sides of the same divine truth. This project helped me see programming as a practice of patience and responsibility.

Author: Group 1
Title: Learning as Service
Body: Technology becomes meaningful when it is shaped by truth, humility, and service to others.
